title: What's New in AL-Go for GitHub: Productivity Enhancements (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Block pull requests on new warnings

features.name: Environment variables for deployment
features.description: Settings can now be placed in environment variables named ALGO_environment_settings and defined for each environment, available only during deployment jobs. This helps declutter the main settings file.
caveats: Does not support runs-on shell and continuous deployment properties
Those properties must be defined in main settings file or repository/organization settings

features.name: Fail on new warnings for pull requests
features.description: The fail-on setting now accepts a new value 'new warning' which compares warnings generated in the pull request build to the last good CI/CD build and blocks the pull request if any new warnings are introduced.
caveats: Does not run on CAC job so CAC warnings do not block CI/CD

features.name: Page scripting test visualizer
features.description: Page scripting test results can now be visualized directly in the build summary, similar to regular and performance tests. No new setting is required and works out of the box.
caveats: Only shows results if page scripting tests are running

features.name: Workflow input validation
features.description: A new feature that validates workflow inputs and fails workflows as early as possible if anything goes wrong. Currently implemented for create release and increment version workflows to catch issues like incorrect version number formats before the workflow partially executes.
caveats: Currently implemented only for create release and increment version workflows

features.name: Settings schema and autocompletion
features.description: AL-Go settings now have schema support in IDEs like Visual Studio Code, providing autocomplete suggestions, tool tips, and direct links to documentation for specific settings. This makes discovering and configuring settings much easier.

features.name: Debug logging enhancements
features.description: Enhanced debug logging focused on providing detailed information to help troubleshoot issues when reporting problems. Debug logs are kept separate from regular logs to avoid clutter while providing useful diagnostic information.
